description:
Neon space shooter 'Star Frontier'. Top-down view. Player spaceship at bottom center. WASD or arrows to move, space or autofire to shoot. Enemies fly from top in waves.

3 enemy types: small bug (fast, 1 hit, zigzag), cruiser (medium, 3 hits, shoots back), boss every 5 waves (huge, 20 hits, 3 attack patterns, screen-wide explosion on death).

Powerups drop from killed enemies: shield 5sec, triple shot 10sec, speed x2. Powerup blinks when expiring.

Visual: dark space with parallax layers (distant stars slow, near stars faster). Muzzle flash on player when shooting. Sparks and glow on enemy hit. Enemy death: explosion of 20+ particles of varying size with fade. Player hit: screen shake 300ms. Player leaves fire trail behind.

HUD: lives icons top-left, score top-center with shadow, wave number top-right, boss progress bar at bottom. All panels with translucent background and rounded corners.

Start: title screen with animated stars, game title with glow effect, 'Press Enter to start'. Pause on ESC. Game over: final score, wave, restart button. Music from start, theme: electronic space.

Difficulty increases: each wave enemies 5% faster, bosses get new attack each time. Combo multiplier for kills without taking damage.

Theme: space. Colors: dark blue space, neon cyan for player, red for enemies, yellow explosions.
title: Star Frontier
